concerns.text: The frontend user interface must be exclusively in Russian. No English or other languages are permitted in UI strings, labels, placeholders, or error messages (e.g., 'Search modules...', 'Recent Searches', 'Trending Modules').
Mobile BottomNavBar items might not meet the 44x44px Fitts's Law touch target minimum (e.g., `<button class="flex flex-col...">`).
Contrast for Quick Filters inactive state (`text-on-surface-variant` on `bg-surface`) may fail WCAG 2.1 AA minimum of 4.5:1.
